description:
Perform a cortical bone assessment for the implant planned at tooth #30 (lower right first molar). 

Starting from the open Blue Sky Plan instance:
1. Navigate to the cross-sectional view centered on the implant at tooth #30.
2. Measure the buccal cortical bone thickness (the dense outer layer of bone on the cheek side) at three specific depths along the implant axis:
   - Crestal: 1mm below the bone crest
   - Mid-body: 5mm below the bone crest
   - Apical: 9mm below the bone crest

3. Record these three measurements in a new text file at 'C:\Users\Docker\Documents\cortical_assessment.txt' using exactly this format:

Cortical Bone Thickness Assessment - Tooth #30
Crestal (1mm): X.X mm
Mid-body (5mm): X.X mm
Apical (9mm): X.X mm

(Replace X.X with your measured values). ensure the file is saved.
